ranked_unrun_hypotheses.name: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline displacement as an independent paleogeodetic datum
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.expected_improvement_qualitative: Moderate conditional potential: a demonstrable offset of a laterally continuous, age-matched shoreline can be a direct displacement signal where modern scarps are subdued. Transfer is uncertain because shoreline deformation may be older than the competition target faults.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High: obtain and pin high-resolution DEM tiles and mapped shoreline geometry; separate shoreline age/level, estimate local wave-cut surfaces, fit displacement/tilt across multiple segments, and preregister positive/negative controls before holdout evaluation.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.targeted_signature: Within a single mapped highstand shoreline level, estimate a locally detrended shoreline bench surface and detect a narrow, strike-coherent step or tilt that offsets the same-age bench across a corridor, repeats on adjacent shoreline segments, and is independently consistent with subsurface structure. The shoreline is a positive displacement marker, not a generic elevation contour or a fault label.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Wave-cut bench relief and variable shoreline facies, local lake-level/age miscorrelation, differential compaction of lacustrine sediment, erosional terrace risers, and volcanic-flow margins. Require multiple same-level segments, map-scale uncertainty, and independent controls.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.availability_decision: NOT_VIABLE_IN_CURRENT_CHECKOUT: required raw 1 m DEM tiles and dated shoreline geometry are absent; direct USGS source access is outside the sandbox egress allowlist.

ranked_unrun_hypotheses.name: Time-ordered earthquake-sequence migration along blind fault planes
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.expected_improvement_qualitative: Low-to-moderate and highly uncertain: temporal migration could identify active concealed fault strands, but local event coverage, catalog completeness, and agreement between active sequences and the competition labels may be sparse.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Very high relative to a native-only raster method: retrieve and quality-filter event origin time, depth, location uncertainty and magnitude; decluster or separate swarms from aftershocks; fit migration/plane hypotheses; then evaluate with spatially buffered folds and negative controls.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.targeted_signature: Repeated, quality-filtered earthquake sequences whose hypocenters migrate coherently along a fitted buried plane or along-strike corridor through time, with sequence direction and depth evolution that persist under completeness thresholds and are not simply a static density hotspot.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Geothermal injection/production swarms, mining blasts, quarry sequences, volcanic or dike-intrusion swarms, aftershock migration on an already mapped fault, and apparent migration caused by changing network detection thresholds or hypocenter uncertainty.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.availability_decision: NOT_VIABLE_IN_CURRENT_CHECKOUT: no local event time series; official endpoint cannot be queried from this sandbox; event completeness and coverage remain unknown.

ranked_unrun_hypotheses.name: Age-tagged geologic-unit contact termination and offset graph
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.expected_improvement_qualitative: Low-to-moderate: potentially precise where several mapped contacts are exposed, but limited recall beneath continuous alluvium and vulnerable to geologic-map scale and compilation artifacts.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High: acquire vector-unit polygons and metadata, harmonize scale/age attributes, remove fault annotations from predictors, construct contact correspondences with map uncertainty, and run explicit offset/shuffled-contact controls.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.targeted_signature: A graph of age- and lithology-matched contact segments in which multiple independent bedrock contacts terminate, step, or show consistent lateral displacement across one candidate corridor, with a corresponding basement/potential-field break. Score displacement and correspondence, not the mere presence of a mapped contact or mapped fault line.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Primary intrusive or volcanic contacts, depositional facies changes, alluvial cover boundaries, map-sheet joins, generalized contacts, age-correlation errors, and georeferencing mismatch.
ranked_unrun_hypotheses.availability_decision: NOT_VIABLE_IN_CURRENT_CHECKOUT: no attributed geologic-unit polygons or verified product coverage are present; do not treat the fault-only derivative as the required layer.
